title: Stabilize icon-only contrast and introduce cancelable loading overlay for compact buttons
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Context:
We continue to see regressions after the token consolidation last quarter that affect icon-only buttons in high-contrast themes and compact densities. Two customer-reported issues (support tickets #2041, #2098) surfaced: (1) focus ring color drifting toward background on theme switch, making keyboard focus hard to perceive, and (2) a persistent loading overlay for compact icon buttons that cannot be cancelled when the triggering action aborts.

Problem statement:
- Icon-only variants lose accessible contrast between the icon and background in dark-high-contrast and legacy-brand themes when pressed/focused.
- Loading state for compact/icon-only buttons shows a full-surface spinner overlay that blocks subsequent interactions and doesn't respect cancel/abort flows (XHR/Fetch abort), which breaks undo/cancel UX for users.

Impact:
- Customer-facing regressions in Console: keyboard navigation and keyboard-only workflows are degraded (medium customer impact).
- Affects product teams using compact toolbars and dense lists across Console and Docs sites.

Proposed solution:
1) Token adjustments: introduce a dedicated token group for "button.icon.foreground.*" and "button.icon.focus.*" that are semantically anchored to surface / inverse-surface tokens rather than generic foreground tokens. This preserves contrast across themes and isolates icon variants from global token remapping.
2) Focus ring standardization: use a 2px focus ring with additive alpha overlay on top of the compact hit area; ensure the focus color is computed via color-contrast helper in CSS so it meets WCAG 2.1 AA for 3:1 for icon-only controls. Add explicit fallback values for legacy-brand theme.
3) Cancelable loading overlay: replace full-surface blocking spinner on icon/compact buttons with a small inline spinner anchored to the icon center and expose an optional "cancelable" prop in the component API. The runtime will listen to AbortSignal and remove overlay immediately on abort. For consumers not using AbortSignal, we add a minimal timeout-based fallback that auto-removes after N seconds and surfaces a transient retry affordance.
4) Migration plan: gradually roll token mapping across Console routes. Add an A/B rollout flag in the Console to enable the new tokens for 10% of traffic while we verify SLOs and accessibility audit results.

Acceptance criteria:
- Icon-only buttons in dark-high-contrast and legacy-brand themes have >= 3:1 contrast for focus state (automated contrast checks in CI).
- Keyboard navigation shows a stable focus ring (2px) for icon-only at both compact and comfortable densities.
- Loading overlay on icon-only/compact buttons is cancelable via AbortSignal; verified with a small harness and manual QA steps.
- No visible layout shift introduced by inline spinner in top-level toolbars.
- Documentation updated (component API docs and migration notes).

Implementation notes for engineers:
- Token names proposed: button.icon.fg, button.icon.fg-hover, button.icon.fg-focus, button.icon.bg-focus-overlay. Add alias mapping to tokens.json and theme overrides to legacy-brand.json.
- Component API: add prop cancelableLoading: boolean and accept signal?: AbortSignal. When signal.aborted remove spinner and optionally call onCancel callback.
- CSS: implement focus ring via outline-offset + box-shadow stack to avoid changing hitbox. Ensure pointer: focus-visible handling.
- Performance: inline spinner should be CSS-only (no new images) and GPU-friendly transforms to avoid jank in dense lists.

Rollout plan:
- Create feature flag ui/button-icon-stable under feature-flags service.
- Canary 10% for one week (internal + selected customers). Monitor Console keyboard navigation telemetry and SLOs.
- After 7 days without regressions, increase to 50% and deprecate old token alias in 30 days.

QA checklist:
- Automated contrast test added to jest-puppeteer suite for desktop and reduced-dpi emulation.
- Manual test plan: keyboard-only navigation, theme switch rapid toggling, aborting requests mid-flight, toolbar density tests.
- Create a small Cypress test to simulate AbortController and ensure spinner is removed.
